summary: Admit the official bounded 5Post cancellation request through the reviewed runtime.

impacts.evidence: The existing cancel worker and registry resolve the shipment account in authenticated tenant scope.
Only the provider UUID and normalized cancellation acknowledgement cross the host boundary.
The existing generic cancellation route now admits 5Post through the registry.
No event envelope or event payload changes.
The existing fivepost LogisticsShipmentCanceler is composed into the builtin runtime.
Existing shipment, approval, operation receipt and audit records are sufficient.
Fixed-host HTTPS, callback-scoped secret, UUID path validation and exact business acknowledgement remain mandatory.
The existing approval-bound worker and idempotency key are retained for the provider write.
The existing cancellation audit and operation receipt remain authoritative.
The host idempotency boundary prevents duplicate external calls after a known acknowledgement; ambiguous writes remain non-retryable.
The transport uses only the official 5Post API host and does not admit callbacks.
Shared HTTP timeout, response-size and error mapping cover the cancellation request.
Removing the fivepost registry branch or support capability immediately closes cancellation.
Deterministic exact-success and business-error tests verify the official route and boundary.
